composables.ActionButton: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.Badge: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.BlurSwitch: A transition wrapper for pages, tabs and the PR's views, which come in the way the person went (rule 105), not a visual component. Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.Card: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.DiffStats: A part of the PR row from the web-port kit in Components.kt (rules 15 and 49). It moves into the mobile kit when the row does.
composables.EmptyState: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.EngineMark: The coloured Claude Code and Codex marks (rule 48); they appear on the Model row and in Settings, not as a component of their own.
composables.FeedbackSpinner: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.FileIcon: A part of the PR row from the web-port kit in Components.kt (rules 15 and 49). It moves into the mobile kit when the row does.
composables.FileStatus: A part of the PR row from the web-port kit in Components.kt (rules 15 and 49). It moves into the mobile kit when the row does.
composables.GithubAvatar: A part of the PR row from the web-port kit in Components.kt (rules 15 and 49). It moves into the mobile kit when the row does.
composables.IconButton: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.IconSwap: A transition wrapper: one icon leaves as the next scales in (rule 73), not a visual component. Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.LabelSwitch: A transition wrapper for a label replaced by its neighbour, such as the file name between the previous and next buttons (rule 105), not a visual component. The Motion page's Label demo shows it.
composables.Loading: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.LuIcon: Drawn for every glyph on the Icons page.
composables.Markdown: Renders the rules on the Rules page.
composables.MarkdownPreview: Markdown's inline text cut to a few lines, for the AI note on an Overview file row; it draws exactly what Markdown draws, whose page is the Rules page.
composables.MenuReveal: A transition wrapper for menus and dropdowns, not a visual component. Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.ModalReveal: A transition wrapper for dialogs (rule 73), not a visual component. The Tour's full-screen diagram uses it.
composables.ModalSurface: What ModalReveal draws inside its window, split out so a test can step it; the Tour's full-screen diagram shows it.
composables.PageBack: Back handling, not a visual component: a back swipe moves the page with the finger and then on that way (rule 105).
composables.PhIcon: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.PrStatusIcon: A part of the PR row from the web-port kit in Components.kt (rules 15 and 49). It moves into the mobile kit when the row does.
composables.ReviewCheckbox: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.SidePages: A transition wrapper for screens that sit side by side, the Inbox and Tours (H20, rule 105), not a visual component. The Motion page's Side by side demo shows it.
composables.themeWipe: A modifier that lets a window take part in the Light and Dark wipe (H5), not a visual component. Switching the theme in Settings shows it.
composables.SendButton: The send circle shown inside the Pill input page's With send variant.
composables.PagedSheetPanel: The inside of PullsPagedSheet (scrim, panel, fixed header, sliding pages), split from the sheet's window so a test can step it; the Sheet page's Pages variant shows the real sheet.
composables.SheetPanel: The inside of PullsSheet (scrim, panel, header and body), split from the sheet's window so a test can step its motion; the Sheet page shows the real sheet.
composables.SpinIcon: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.ToggleGroup: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.edgeFade: A modifier: it fades scrolled content into the page, with a blur that grows toward the edge, under a pinned header or bar (rule 74). Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.faded: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.floatShadow: Shown at each elevation on the Elevation page.
composables.headerTopPadding: A layout helper that returns the header's top padding, not a visual component.
composables.ink: A TextStyle helper, not a visual component.
composables.rememberMotionEnabled: A check on the system "Remove animations" setting, not a component. Looping effects such as the thinking shimmer read it (rules 72 and 73).
composables.rememberPageSlide: A transition helper for the rows of a lazy list whose tabs change the page under them (rule 73), not a visual component. Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.spin: The web-port kit in Components.kt, frozen by the bans check (rule 49). It has no page because it is being replaced by the mobile kit.
composables.t: An i18n lookup, not a visual component.
composables.tc: An i18n lookup, not a visual component.
composables.sideFade: A modifier: edgeFade for content that scrolls sideways, so what runs past an edge dissolves into the page (rule 74, J14). Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.sideScrollFade: A modifier: sideFade driven by a row's own scroll, so an edge with nothing past it stays sharp (rule 74, J14). Its recipe is on the Motion page.
composables.rememberSidePages: The state of a row of side by side pages, hoisted so a header and tabs can follow and drag them (rules 107 and 118). It is not drawn; SidePages draws the pages.
composables.FieldText: The one text field every kit field is built on (N6, N9); the Pill input, Sheet search and Sheet field pages show it in each of its frames.
composables.FieldFrame: The white frame of the framed fields, a pill at the bottom of a page or a card's corner on a sheet (N6); the Pill input and Sheet search pages show both.
composables.FieldClear: The ✕ inside a field once something is typed; the Sheet search page's typed state shows it.
composables.FootBarLayer: The host that draws the page's foot pill once over every page (rule 196), placed in PullsApp, not a visual component. The Foot pill page shows what it draws.
composables.FootFree: Hands a page's own bar, the diff's file bar, to the foot host in the pill's place (rule 196); it draws only what the page gives it.
composables.rememberMessages: Loads the shared web locale catalog from native bundled resources; it provides translation state, not a visual component.

components.toast: ToastHost is one host for the whole app and draws at the bottom of the screen, so it cannot be measured inline. Its page shows the real one.
